lanes.title: SVS vs lyrics-to-song routes (STUDY-001 score-lock reopen)

findings.title: SoulX-Singer: Towards High-Quality Zero-Shot Singing Voice Synthesis
findings.finding: Score-control mode takes MIDI + lyrics only; MIDI timing constraints lower WER vs melody-only F0 mode under lyric rewrite.
findings.implication: Score-native MIDI+lyrics path; deepen wave-03 score-lock axis.

findings.title: DiTSinger: Scaling Singing Voice Synthesis with Diffusion Transformer and Implicit Alignment
findings.finding: DiT SVS conditioned on pitch, phonemes, word durations, slur; still score-bound (implicit alignment does not drop MIDI).
findings.implication: Implicit alignment stays score-bound; not a free song generator.

findings.title: LeVo: High-Quality Song Generation with Multi-Preference Alignment
findings.finding: Lyrics (+ optional text/audio prompts) → mixed song; BPM/structure labels, not note-level MIDI lock.

findings.title: SongGen: A Single Stage Auto-regressive Transformer for Text-to-Song Generation
findings.finding: Single-stage text-to-song (lyrics + descriptions ± voice clip); no MIDI note hard constraint.

findings.title: DiffSinger Best Practices
findings.finding: Acoustic inputs are fixed to phoneme seq + phoneme duration + F0; narrow variance knobs are energy, breathiness, voicing, tension — no named register or singer-formant control.

findings.title: OpenUtau default expressions (USTx.cs)
findings.finding: Editor surface maps gender/g (−100…100, formant shift), breath/B, breathiness curve, tension curve, voicing curve — production path for DiffSinger/resampler timbre, still not a register enum.
findings.implication: Breathiness/tension/gender on hard F0; no register enum.

findings.title: Cantor Digitalis (Web Audio) README
findings.finding: Perceptual API exposes isFalsetto (M1/M2), tenseness, breathiness, vocalTractSize, and synth-level F1–F6 formant centers — register is an explicit boolean, not an F0 label.
findings.implication: Only parametric surfaces expose isFalsetto + formants.

findings.title: Cantor Digitalis tech notes
findings.finding: Docs state the singing formant is produced by grouping F3–F5, with hypo-pharynx anti-resonance ~2.5–3.5 kHz — formant cluster is a tract setting, not painted EQ.
findings.implication: Singer formant is tract setting (F3–F5 cluster).

findings.title: WORLD README
findings.finding: Public API is F0 + spectral envelope (CheapTrick) + aperiodicity (D4C) → synthesize; no register or singer-formant parameter names — envelope is opaque.

findings.title: nnsvs.gen class reference
findings.finding: Score-locked path predicts/post-processes mgc, lf0, vuv, bap; relative_f0 ties LF0 to MIDI score pitch; vibrato_scale and phone V/UV flags exist — source-filter streams, not named formant/register knobs.

findings.title: vocal-synth-engine README
findings.finding: Additive + spectral envelope + noise; cockpit/API exposes per-note breathiness, timbre, vibrato, portamento and XY timbre×breathiness — no documented singer-formant or falsetto/register field on VocalScore.

findings.title: ACE-Step 1.5 Inference API
findings.finding: GenerationParams metadata is caption/lyrics + bpm / keyscale / timesignature / duration — no note MIDI, no register, no formant; song-generator surface opposite the SVS craft axis.

lanes.title: Lyric alignment analogs (STUDY-001 Analogist; Sundberg omitted)

findings.title: Source Level Debugging with LLVM
findings.finding: Analog: source AST objects map onto instruction ranges via debug metadata. Holds for discrete lyric/score tokens ↔ audio-frame spans under score-lock; limit: no continuous-time melisma or expressive lag.

findings.title: Towards Context-Aware Neural Performance-Score Synchronisation
findings.finding: Analog: Needleman–Wunsch Time Warping / DTW map performance ↔ score with warps and jumps. Holds for monotonic lyric↔timeline alignment; limit: classic NW/DTW assume structural agreement.

findings.title: RFC 5905 NTPv4
findings.finding: Analog: two clocks share a reference; undisciplined skew accumulates. Holds for jam startSec vs Seed Audio [start:end] as dual timelines.
findings.implication: Dual clocks: jam startSec vs seed [start:end].

findings.title: Impact of Latency on Perceptual Judgments… in VR
findings.finding: Analog: HCI simultaneity / agency thresholds; delays above ~75 ms worsen felt sync. Holds for practice-companion UX of lyric lock; limit: perceptual threshold ≠ phoneme-boundary / MFA error.
findings.implication: ~75 ms UX threshold for lyric lock feel.

findings.title: When are initial consonants articulated in choral performance?
findings.finding: Analog: music pedagogy — initial consonants nearly always anticipated; vowel on the beat; lengthenability + surroundings matter. Holds strongly for lyric-to-note craft.

findings.title: Montreal Forced Aligner user guide
findings.finding: Analog: speech forced alignment (Kaldi GMM/HMM orthography→phones). Does not transfer cleanly to singing — speech pipeline applied to sung duration variance.
findings.implication: Leave MFA speech→singing caveats unverified as transfer.

findings.title: Specifying Systems (TLA)
findings.finding: Analog: verification — Spec = Init ∧ □[Next]; stuttering steps are unobservable. Partial hold: expressive microtiming as stuttering around a score Spec; limit: discrete state machines, no continuous F0.
